summary: Your first teach-back. You sketch the path of a request from memory, explain it in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note, check it against six key points, and prove it with a print line and your own server log.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences what happens between a request and your function, and prove it with your own server log.

items.text: Sketch every stop from the client to your function from memory
Explain the path in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note, without notes
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Add a print to chat(), send four requests and see the print only once in the server log
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and save your five sentences
Play the Request Journey game to the end and see your score
